category_title: Socially withdrawn learners characterized by fear of mockery, isolation, and lack of social initiative
scenario_title: Answering direct questions during whole-class lessons
minimal_context: The student is asked to answer a direct question and express her opinion in front of her classmates during a whole-class lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Santa, please answer the question and express your opinion before the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at her desk and does nothing) I didn't understand something, but I used to do nothing as I didn't dare to ask for an explanation neither teachers nor classmates.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try. Tell everyone what you think.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why should I say something if nobody cares... I don't know, it was unpleasant to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are waiting for your answer. Please speak up so the class can hear you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to answer the question and keeps quiet) It's better not to say anything and keep quiet so that nobody notices you rather than let them laugh at you.
